purpose: Six fixed, non-overlapping 63-question CCAR-P practice papers (Practice exam 1-6), plus the existing random mix.

pool.note: Every pool item appears in exactly one paper. Existing-bank items are reused under a PX- prefix with wording overrides in ccar-p.papers-overrides.js; the source bank is unchanged. Paper contents are seeded separately from the layout version, so v2 keeps the same six papers as v1.

constraints: Every paper matches the exam's seven-domain weights and the 44/14/5 item-type mix of the existing exam simulation.
Every paper covers all 38 exam-guide objectives and never repeats a concept family.
Correct-answer positions are balanced (20-30% per position across all single-answer items, at most 40% within one paper).
The correct choice is the longest in at most 40% of single-answer items; both correct choices are the two longest in at most 40% of multiple-response items.
Question stems within a paper have word overlap (Jaccard) below 0.6.
contentProvenance: Original practice content written for this repository. No live, recalled or third-party exam content. Every item has liveExamContent set to false.

formatReference.description: A user-supplied list of commercial CCAR-P mock-exam products was consulted for format facts only: 63 questions, 120 minutes, single-answer and multiple-response items, and sets of six full-length papers.

followUps: Updated CCAR-P exam guides are due November 17, 2026, with content effective December 7, 2026. Re-verify objectives and weights against the new guide and rebuild the layout.
The 68 drill questions were rewritten; the remaining practice-bank questions outside the papers and the drill still need the same answer-set review.
D6 objectives have little dedicated official documentation; their links point to the closest official guidance (success criteria, evaluations, outcomes).

comprehension.sourceLinks: Every paper and drill question links to official Anthropic pages (platform.claude.com/docs, code.claude.com/docs, anthropic.com, trust.anthropic.com), chosen by topic and exam-guide objective in ccar-p.sources.js. URLs and section anchors were checked against the live pages on 2026-11-06.
comprehension.reviewRationales: The post-exam review shows the rationale for every choice, tagged Correct and Your answer, so a learner sees why each plausible alternative loses. Correct answers flagged for review are included.
comprehension.newQuestionScore: Results report a separate score on questions the learner had not seen before (matched by question text), so retakes can't hide memorization.
comprehension.retakeShuffle: On a retake, choices for questions already seen appear in a new order.
comprehension.adaptiveMix: After the six papers, the default is an adaptive 63-question form with exam geometry, weighted toward weak objectives, missed questions and unseen questions.
comprehension.targetedPractice: After each exam, a 12-question drill on the missed objectives with instant feedback and source links, drawn from 68 reworded bank questions that no paper uses. Their answer sets were rewritten (ccar-p.drill-items-*.js) with plausible alternatives and a rationale for every choice.
